items: 2 large broccoli heads, cut into bite sized pieces

steps: Bring a large pot of water to boil and add in to broccoli, cook for 2 minutes and remove with slotted spoon.
Add salt to boiling water and cook pasta according to packet directions, removing 1 cup of pasta water before draining.
Place all pasta sauce ingredients in a jar with a lid along with a ½ cup of pasta water and shake well.
Add pasta, broccoli, shredded cheese and sauce back to the cooking pot, stir vigorously, garnish with salt and pepper and serve.

notes: Any short pasta is fine, macaroni, twirls, penne, ziti, orecchiette etc.

recipe_info.title: Broccoli Lemon Pasta
recipe_info.intro: Quick and simple broccoli pasta, works best with smaller shaped pastas. For a more delicious and complex pasta, try the broccoli miso pasta variant.
